name: Sigmax model-aware profiles
plain: A large pack composing schedules from named parts (base grid, shift, terminal policy) per model profile, with strict validity checks. Base grids and shifts were read. Profile choice and turbo presets were read only for the LTX table.
math:
Base: (n−i)/n reciprocal, table-matching simple grid, or linear endpoints.
Shift: logistic(μ−e·ln((1−t)/t)), or ratio form 1/(1+(1−t)/(r·t)).
Terminal: preserve or append 0.
LTX table: (1, .99375, .9875, .98125, .975, .909375, .725, .421875, 0).
label: from code
surprise: The Sigmax LTX stage-1 table equals the PowerShift pack's BASE_SIGMA_POINTS with a final 0 (ltx.py:496; ComfyUI_PowerShiftScheduler __init__.py:17), so that 'default curve' is the LTX stage-1 ladder (equality read from both files; provenance inferred).
